learning_outcomes.text: Engineers will frequently have to participate in structural decisions (investments, reorganization, new products, ...) and management decisions (decisions regarding purchasing, production, maintenance, project monitoring, storage and distribution, ...). They need a general understanding of opportunities within business operations.
Knowledge of internal and external business economic reporting as well as business organizational structures.
Knowledge and application of a number of business economic calculation methods and organizational techniques.
To be able to reproduce basic concepts, connections, and structures insightfully and to be able to use them in the interpretation of (new) business situations.
To be able to insightfully apply working methods and techniques in solving new problems.
Orientation towards the business economic and business organizational interpretation of business operations.

The student can analyze a certain situation or problem in the field of business and production organization, list shortcomings, formulate and propose solutions with pros and cons. They are able to see the coherence between the different chapters.

The student can apply the theory to different business situations. The student analyzes the problem and then applies the correct technique to solve the problem. The solution can be achieved through calculations or by writing a proposal for improvement.

assessment_rules: A penalty for incorrect answers will be applied during the multiple-choice exam.
